2.text: kuko nzi umutima wanyu ukunze ari wo mbirataho mu Banyamakedoniya, mbabwira yuko Abanyakaya bamaze umwaka biteguye, kandi ko guhirimbana kwanyu kwateye abenshi umwete.

3.text: Ariko natumye bene Data abo, kugira ngo uko kwirata twirata mwebwe kutazapfa ubusa, kandi no kugira ngo muzabe mwiteguye nk'uko nababwiye,

4.text: kuko ntashaka ko twebwe (simvuze mwe) tuzakorwa n'isoni z'ibyo twiringiye, niba Abanyamakedoniya bamwe bazazana nanjye bagasanga mutiteguye.

5.text: Ni cyo cyatumye nibwira yuko nkwiriye kwinginga bene Data abo kumbanziriza kujya iwanyu, ngo babanze gutunganya iby'ubuntu mwasezeranije kera, bibe byiteguwe nk'iby'ubuntu koko bitameze nk'iby'ubugūgu.

6.text: Ariko ndavuga ibi ngo “Ubiba nke azasarura bike, naho ubiba nyinshi azasarura byinshi.”

7.text: Umuntu wese atange nk'uko abigambiriye mu mutima we, atinuba kandi adahatwa kuko Imana ikunda utanga anezerewe.

8.text: Kandi rero Imana ishobora kubasāzaho ubuntu bwose, kugira ngo murusheho gukora ibyiza byose, mufite ibibahagije muri byose

9.text: nk'uko byanditswe ngo“Yaranyanyagije aha abakene,Gukiranuka kwe guhoraho iteka ryose.”

10.text: Iha umubibyi imbuto n'imitsima yo kumugaburira ni yo izabaha, ibongerere imbuto zanyu zo kubiba kandi igwize imbuto zo gukiranuka kwanyu.

11.text: Namwe muzatungishwa muri byose ngo mugire ubuntu bwose, butume Imana ihimbazwa.

12.text: Kuko uwo murimo wo kugabura utamara gusa ubukene bw'abera, ahubwo utera benshi guhimbaza Imana,

13.text: bayihimbaza ku bw'ubuhamya bw'uyu murimo mwitangiye, mukemera kugandukira ubutumwa bwiza bwa Kristo, mukagira ubuntu bwinshi bwo kubafasha no gufasha abandi bose.

14.text: Ku bw'ubuntu bw'Imana burushijeho kuba muri mwe, ni cyo gituma babasabira no kubakunda cyane.

15.text: Imana ishimirwe impano yayo nziza itarondoreka.
